name: kurei_idle
desc: Pixel art game sprite, side view, full body from head to tail tip, standing idle pose on four legs facing left. A big, heavy, burly four-legged dragon with a glossy clay-like body: shiny teal skin with cream-yellow throat, chest, belly, and underside of the tail. A big, round, full cream belly. Thick neck, long sturdy body, thick strong legs with big grey claws. Thick tail ending in a wide fin-shaped tip. Spiky blond hair that runs from the head down the neck and back like a mane, small salmon-pink triangular spikes along the back, short salmon-orange stripes on the snout, cheeks and front legs. Two dark grey horns at the back of the head, a large curved tan-brown horn arching forward over the eye, cream furry ears. Yellow eyes with white sclera and slit black pupils, half-lidded with a sly, mean, smug look, small white fang, the tip of an orange-brown tongue showing. Small blobs of teal and cream goo dripping from the belly, legs and tail tip onto the ground. Plain flat background, the dragon alone.
refs: the character head and face in side view: half-lidded sly yellow eye, smug mean expression, horns, blond hair, snout shape, colors
the character full body: four-legged body shape, fin-tipped tail, legs and grey claws, dripping goo blobs; drawn cute and simplified, so make the body bulkier
